post.description: Creates a new user account. The password is hashed before it is stored.
Returns a short-lived access token in the body. The refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie and never appears in the body.
Reads the refresh cookie, exchanges it for a new access token and a new refresh cookie (rotation). Reusing an old cookie revokes the whole login.
Revokes the refresh cookie's login and clears the cookie. Always returns 204, so it is safe to call twice.

post.summary: Attach or replace the proof of payment
post.description: multipart/form-data with one file field named "file". The contribution's own member, or a Treasurer or Chairperson of this stokvel. JPEG, PNG or PDF, decided by the file's first bytes (never its name or Content-Type), at most 5 MB. Uploading again replaces the proof while the cycle is open. Once the cycle is closed or paid out it is locked (409).

delete.description: Same people as upload, and only while the cycle is open (otherwise 409 proof-locked).

get.description: Only the contribution's member and this stokvel's Treasurer or Chairperson. Everyone else, including an ordinary member of the same stokvel and a treasurer of another stokvel, gets the same 404 as a contribution with no proof. The file is sent as an attachment with the detected Content-Type, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.summary: List a stokvel's contributions, one page at a time
get.description: Filters, sorting and paging all run in the database. pageSize defaults to 20 and is capped at 100; sort is recordedAt (default) or amount, prefixed with '-' for descending. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page; an empty nextPageToken means there are no more results. minAmountCents and maxAmountCents filter by amount, in integer cents. from and to are UTC instants in ISO 8601 ending in Z, compared with recordedAt in the database: from is INCLUDED and to is EXCLUDED, so one range ends exactly where the next begins. memberUserId must belong to this stokvel. A pageToken only works with the same filter and sort that produced it (otherwise 400, code page-token-filter-mismatch).

post.description: Records a member's payment for a stokvel cycle. Any member can record their own. Recording for another member needs the Treasurer or Chairperson role in this stokvel. The member must belong to the stokvel. Requires an Idempotency-Key header, and rejects a second contribution from the same member for the same cycle.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh UUID per attempt. Retrying the same request with the same key replays the first result instead of recording twice.

get.description: Returns a single contribution, scoped to this stokvel.
Any member of the stokvel can list its cycles.

post.description: Pays the cycle's total contributions to one member and closes the cycle. Treasurer or Chairperson only.

get.description: Treasurer or Chairperson of THIS stokvel only (a member gets 403, a non-member 404). Shows who would be in arrears if the cycle were closed now, counted up to asOfDate (the cycle's last day, or today if it is still running). It uses the same calculation as the real close. Send the returned version back to close; it changes whenever anything that affects the result changes. An empty arrears list is valid.

post.description: Treasurer or Chairperson of THIS stokvel only. Body: the version from the preview. Requires an Idempotency-Key header. If the version no longer matches a fresh calculation nothing is closed (409 close-preview-stale). If the cycle is already closed, by the nightly job or another treasurer (409 cycle-already-closed). Otherwise it is closed exactly once, in one transaction with the arrears rows. The same Idempotency-Key repeated returns the original 200 and records the arrears once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh UUID per attempt. Retrying the same request with the same key replays the first result instead of recording twice.

post.description: Treasurer or Chairperson of THIS stokvel only. Returns a code that works for 7 days. Anyone signed in who has the code can preview the stokvel and join it.

get.description: What someone who may not be a member yet is allowed to see: the stokvel's name, rules, contribution amount, frequency and cycle length, how many members it has, when the invite expires, and whether the caller is already in. Nothing about its members, balances, contributions or payout order. Guesses are rate-limited per user.

post.summary: Join a stokvel with an invite
post.description: Adds the caller as a Member. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: the same key replays the original 201, and the database allows one membership per person per stokvel, so a double click or a retry never joins twice. Already a member is a 409 (code already-member) with the stokvelId.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A fresh UUID per attempt. Retrying the same request with the same key replays the first result instead of recording twice.

get.description: The signed-in member: id, email and full name. Never includes the password hash. Their role is not here because a role belongs to one stokvel; /me/home returns it per stokvel.

One card per stokvel the caller belongs to: their role, the current cycle, what they have paid and still owe this cycle (integer cents), and the next payout date (a South African calendar date). currentCycle is an object with its dates (endsOn is the due date), or null when no cycle is open; paid and owed are then 0. An empty list if they belong to none.

Contributions recorded, payouts made and members joined, across ONLY the stokvels the caller belongs to, newest first. pageSize defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Pass nextPageToken back as pageToken for the next page; nextPageToken is an empty string ("") on the last page. occurredAt is UTC and ends in Z. amountCents is null when no money is involved. personName is the member the line is about, and is null once they are no longer in that stokvel.
Returns the stokvels the signed-in user belongs to.

post.description: Creates a new stokvel. The creator is automatically enrolled as its first member, with the Chairperson role.

get.description: Returns a single stokvel, including its current members with their names and roles, the member count and its current cycle (null when no cycle is open) with the cents collected and due.

post.summary: Add a member to a stokvel
post.description: Enrolls a user into the stokvel with the given role. Chairperson only. Fails if the user is already a member.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a stokvel
delete.description: Removes the member. Refuses to remove the last admin, so a stokvel always has someone who can run it. Does not delete the member's past contributions.

put.description: Changes a member's role within the stokvel. Refuses a change that would leave the stokvel without an admin.

AccessTokenResponse.description: What the client sees after login or refresh. The refresh token travels only in the cookie.

ActivityItem.description:
One line in the signed-in member's activity feed. Only stokvels the member belongs to ever appear.
Id is unique and stable, but opaque: do not parse it. OccurredAt is UTC and ends in Z.
AmountCents is null when no money is involved (MemberJoined). PersonName is the member the line is about
(who paid, who was paid, who joined), and is null when that person is no longer a member of the stokvel.

ActivityKind.description: What happened. Sent as the name (for example "ContributionRecorded").

ArrearItem.description: One member who still owes money for a cycle. Money is integer cents.

CloseCycleRequest.description: The Version from the preview the treasurer looked at.

CloseCycleResponse.description: A cycle that was closed, with the arrears that were recorded.

ClosePreviewResponse.description:
What closing a cycle WOULD do right now. AsOfDate is the South African calendar date the close counts up to (the cycle's
last day, or today if it is still running). An empty Arrears list is valid: nobody owes anything.
Version is opaque: send it back unchanged to close. It identifies the exact inputs of this calculation, so it changes
when anything that affects the result changes, and a close that carries an older one is refused (409).

ContributionResponse.description:
A contribution. Money is integer cents; RecordedAt is UTC and ends in Z. HasProof says whether a proof of payment is attached;
CanDownloadProof says whether THE CALLER may download it (the same rule as the download itself).

CreateStokvelRequest.description: The contribution amount is integer cents (R500 is 50000).

HomeCurrentCycle.description:
The stokvel's open cycle. EndsOn is the due date. StartsOn and EndsOn are
null only for a cycle created before cycles had dates.

HomeResponse.description:
Exactly what the member home screen shows: one card per stokvel the caller
belongs to. Only the caller's own amounts; no member lists.

HomeStokvelCard.description:
Money is integer cents (exact in JavaScript); dates are South African
calendar dates ("2026-10-31"), not UTC dates.

frequency.description: How often a cycle comes round.

cycleLengthDays.description: 7 or 14 for weekly and bi-weekly; null for monthly (a calendar month).

alreadyMember.description: Whether the caller is already in this stokvel.

InvitePreviewResponse.description:
What a person sees before they join, and ONLY this. It has no member names, no user ids, no balances,
no contributions and no payout order: the caller is not a member yet, so none of that is theirs to see.

InviteResponse.description: A new invite. The code is the whole secret: anyone who has it can read the preview and join.

PagedResponseOfActivityItem.description:
One page of a list endpoint. NextPageToken is opaque to the client:
pass it back as ?pageToken= to get the next page. An empty string
means this is the last page. No total count, on purpose — counting
would cost an extra COUNT(*) query on every page.

PagedResponseOfContributionResponse.description:
One page of a list endpoint. NextPageToken is opaque to the client:
pass it back as ?pageToken= to get the next page. An empty string
means this is the last page. No total count, on purpose — counting
would cost an extra COUNT(*) query on every page.

PayoutResponse.description: A payout. Money is integer cents; PaidAt is UTC and ends in Z.

correlationId.description: The reference a member can quote to support. Also written to the server log.

traceId.description: The W3C trace id of the request.

ProofResponse.description: The proof attached to a contribution, without its bytes.

RecordContributionRequest.description:
What the caller sends to record a contribution. StokvelId is
deliberately not a field here — it comes from the route
(POST /api/stokvels/{stokvelId}/contributions) so a client can never
send a body that disagrees with the URL it actually called.
The amount is integer cents (R100.50 is 10050).

StokvelDetailResponse.description:
One stokvel with the numbers its page shows. Money is integer cents; EndsOn is a
South African calendar date. CurrentCycle is null when no cycle is open.

StokvelMembershipResponse.description:
FullName is filled in by the stokvel detail endpoint, so a Treasurer can pick a member by name.
It is null in the other responses that list members.

UserResponse.description:
What a User looks like over the wire — deliberately excludes
PasswordHash so it can never leak into a response body.

correlationId.description: The reference a member can quote to support. Also written to the server log.

traceId.description: The W3C trace id of the request.
